title: Common providers: Belgium
coverage: Complete for the national fixed-line carrier, the cable operators, the mobile network operators and the wholesale access networks; business ISPs are partial.
missing: AS numbers for the wholesale access networks, Scarlet and DIGI (none confirmed)
A website for Citymesh (it refused an automated request)

sources.name: BIPT (Belgian Institute for Postal Services and Telecommunications)
sources.terms: Conditions of use: information may be used free of charge with the source named, for strictly personal use only: nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date; no list of notified operators was found on it. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Belgium
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 5 of 16 candidate names were found on the page (the name as listed; other names of an entry were not looked up).

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Belgium
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 5 of 16 candidate names were found on the page (the name as listed; other names of an entry were not looked up).

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 15 of 16 websites answered one plain automated request; an address that did not answer, or that refused it, is left empty. No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 12 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: RIPE Database full-text search (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The database terms were not read on the read date: nothing is copied. Searched by company name to find candidate AS numbers; each was then confirmed as the entries above and below say.
sources.result: Candidate numbers found for some providers; none was taken without the confirmation.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 4 entries carry the id of their own Wikidata item; each item states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797). A parent group's item is not used.

sources.name: ITdaily: Orange Belgium and VOO merge
sources.terms: Cited for a date and a name (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above: the merger was completed on 1 October 2025; the VOO name stays on some products.

providers.name: Telenet
providers.notes: Cable in Flanders and Brussels, and mobile (BASE); owned by Liberty Global.

providers.name: Orange Belgium
providers.notes: Mobile, and cable in Wallonia and Brussels. VOO merged into it on 1 October 2025; AS12392 was VOO's.

providers.name: Scarlet
providers.notes: Low-cost name of Proximus; it runs on the Proximus network.

providers.name: DIGI
providers.notes: The fourth mobile network operator; fibre in some areas.

providers.name: Wyre
providers.notes: Wholesale cable and fibre network in Flanders (Telenet and Fluvius).

providers.name: Fiberklaar
providers.notes: Wholesale fibre access network in Flanders; retail through Proximus and others.

providers.name: Unifiber
providers.notes: Wholesale fibre access network in Wallonia; retail through Proximus and others.

providers.name: Eurofiber
providers.notes: Uses the AS number of Eurofiber (Netherlands pack): where NetBox already holds Eurofiber, this entry resolves to it.

providers.name: Belnet
providers.notes: The national research and education network.
